description: Pituwala Kankamge Gunawathie v. Uberis Blok and Another Pituwala Kankamge Gunawathie v. Uberis Blok and Another View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: Pituwala Kankamge Gunawathie v. Uberis Blok and Another Pituwala Kankamge Gunawathie v. Uberis Blok and Another View More
keywords: This Appeal arises from an interlocutory decree in a partition action, where the Appellant is not a co-owner of the corpus but claims prescriptive title to a specific portion of the corpus. Held - bona fide possessor has right to retain possession until due compensation is paid; jus retentionis is not adverse possession; Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
